-  Currently enrolled in an undergraduate, graduate, or master’s program in Software Development, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.

role: GTM Intern – Developer Relations & Technical Content
jd:
About NeuroSpark

NeuroSpark builds and operates a high-performance AI inference platform that helps enterprises run large language models faster, cheaper, and at scale. Inference infrastructure is the foundation the entire AI application layer runs on — every AI product ultimately depends on how fast, how reliably, and how affordably models can serve their users. Our vision is to make that layer so efficient that compute is never the reason a good AI product fails.

About The Role

We are looking for a Go-to-Market Intern focused on developer relations, technical content, and community building.

You will partner with engineering and GTM to turn complex infrastructure topics into useful developer education, engage technical communities, and grow awareness of NeuroSpark.

What You Will Do

Technical Content & Developer Education



- Write technical blogs, tutorials, and developer-focused content on LLM inference, APIs, model deployment, and infrastructure.
- Translate engineering insights, product updates, and technical concepts into clear, engaging articles.
- Create API walkthroughs, quick-start guides, and practical application examples; improve developer documentation.

Developer Relations & Community Building



- Engage developers across GitHub, Discord, Reddit, LinkedIn, X, and relevant AI/ML communities.
- Help answer developer questions, collect feedback, and identify open-source collaboration opportunities.
- Support meetups, hackathons, workshops, and other developer community initiatives.

GTM & Developer Marketing



- Support developer-focused launches, newsletters, product announcements, and campaigns.
- Research AI tooling trends, competing inference platforms, and developer needs.
- Track content performance, community engagement, and developer adoption; propose and execute experiments.

Who We Are Looking For



- Current Student: pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Technical Communication, Marketing, Business, Economics or a related field.
- Team Player: Outstanding English writing skills and the ability to explain technical concepts clearly; proactive and comfortable in a fast-paced startup environment.
- Interest in AI: Familiarity with LLMs, generative AI, APIs, or developer tools; interest in AI infrastructure and developer communities.
- Highly prefer living in the San Francisco Bay Area; occasional in-person presence required.

Nice to Have



- Community Builder: Published technical blogs, documentation, tutorials, GitHub projects, or open-source contributions; Experience with developer communities, hackathons, technical events, SEO, or content analytics.
- Coding & AI: Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, REST APIs, or LLM APIs.
- AI Inference: Familiarity with vLLM, Hugging Face, Ollama, or AI model serving.

What Success Looks Like



- Community: Publish useful technical content that helps developers understand and adopt NeuroSpark.
- Connection: Grow meaningful developer engagement and improve onboarding resources.
- Conversion: Contribute to measurable experiments that increase developer awareness and adoption.

Compensation & Opportunities



- $20/hour; hybrid internship based in the San Francisco Bay Area.
- Work directly with engineering and GTM teams and own meaningful projects at an early-stage startup.

jd:
Summer 2027 AI Full Stack Developer Consulting Intern 
 AI-Assisted Code | CI/CD & DevOps 
 Location: Minneapolis, Mn (Hybrid but based in Mn for summer) 
Dates: June 1 - August 21, 2027 (10–12 weeks) 
Status: Internship | Full-Time | Paid 
Eligibility: Undergraduate, Master’s, Graduate-Level or PhD Students  
Extension:   Potential extension; remote work may be considered 

 Elire and Role Overview  
 Elire is a trusted Oracle consulting partner with over 20 years of experience delivering ERP, EPM, HCM, and Treasury transformations across public and private sector clients using PeopleSoft, Oracle Cloud, and Treasury Management Systems such as Kyriba and FIS. We combine deep business and technical expertise with a people-first, consulting-driven approach to help organizations modernize systems, improve decision-making, and prepare for the future of work. 
 As AI continues to reshape how organizations operate, Elire is investing in responsible, human-in-the-loop AI solutions that enhance - not replace - our consultants and clients. Our Summer 2027 AI Full Stack Developer Consulting Internship program gives advanced graduate students hands-on exposure to applied AI in a real consulting environment, with an emphasis on practical problem-solving, sound technical judgment, and work that can move from concept toward usable solutions. 
 
 The Opportunity 
 The AI Full Stack Developer Consulting Intern will focus on building and reviewing software in an AI-enabled development environment. This role is designed for a strong programmer who can assess code written or assisted by AI, identify issues, improve quality, and work within modern software delivery practices including source control, CI/CD, GitOps, and DevOps. The right candidate will be comfortable both creating code and challenging whether generated code is secure, maintainable, testable, and fit for purpose. 
 
 Key Responsibilities:  
 
• Develop, review, test, debug, and improve code used in Elire AI prototypes, tools, integrations, and internal solutions. 
• Review AI-generated or AI-assisted code for correctness, maintainability, performance, security, and alignment with development standards. 
• Build or support scripts, services, APIs, automations, and proof-of-value applications using appropriate programming languages and frameworks. 
• Work with Git-based source control, branching, pull requests, code review, and version-management practices. 
• Support CI/CD workflows and help automate build, test, deployment, and validation processes. 
• Apply GitOps and DevOps concepts to improve repeatability, traceability, and reliability of software delivery. 
• Troubleshoot technical issues, evaluate alternative solutions, and explain the reasoning behind implementation decisions. 
• Document code, workflows, testing results, and technical recommendations; collaborate with Elire AI and technical leaders and present a final project.
 
 Required Qualifications:  
 
• Currently pursuing an Undergraduate, Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Network Engineering, Cloud Computing, Engineering, or a closely related technical field. 
• Strong understanding of networking fundamentals including IP addressing, subnets, routing, DNS, connectivity, and network security concepts. 
• Hands-on knowledge of virtual cloud networking / VCN concepts and cloud infrastructure. 
• Experience with Kubernetes (K8s), RKE2, or comparable container-orchestration technologies. 
• Understanding of cluster deployment, scaling, availability, and troubleshooting concepts. 
• Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills; able to diagnose technical issues and make reasoned infrastructure recommendations. 
• Ability to document architectures, configurations, issues, and technical decisions clearly and professionally. 
 Preferred Qualifications

• Hands-on exposure to CI/CD platforms, GitOps workflows, DevOps tooling, or infrastructure-as-code practices. 
• Experience with containers, Docker, Kubernetes, or cloud-native application development. 
• Exposure to generative AI APIs, coding copilots, LLM-based development workflows, or agentic development tools. 
• Exposure to cloud platforms such as Oracle Cloud, AWS, Azure, or GCP. 
• Prior research, internship, open-source, or project experience building production-oriented software or AI-enabled applications. What You’ll Gain:  
 
• Real-world experience applying AI and advanced technology in a consulting and enterprise environment. 
• Hands-on work with experienced consultants, technical leaders, and Elire innovation initiatives. 
• Professional development focused on critical thinking, communication, problem-solving, and client-ready delivery. 
• The opportunity to own meaningful work and present findings or a final project at the end of the internship. 
• Potential consideration for an internship extension based on business need and performance; an extension may be remote. 
 Who Will Be Successful 
 This internship is intended for someone who is technically capable, curious, self-directed, and comfortable being challenged. We are looking for a graduate student who can do the work, think critically about the work, ask strong questions, and use AI as a tool without outsourcing technical judgment to it. 
 
 About Elire:  
 Elire is a Certified Partner of Oracle Cloud, PeopleSoft, Kyriba, and FIS. Established in 2005, Elire is a Minneapolis-based full-service consulting firm with 15+ years of experience in successfully completing projects for our customers all over the country. Over one hundred clients in the Public and Fortune 500 Financial, Services, and Utilities Sectors have benefited from Elire’s hands-on guidance and knowledge.   
 We help achieve success by efficiently implementing, integrating, and upgrading software investments. We employ consultants with world-class skills and experience. To learn more, visit our website at www.elire.com   
 Elire is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We encourage all qualified candidates to apply, regardless of race, color, gender, age, religion, national origin, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, or veteran status.
